messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: High 5xx rate detected on dedicated cluster solstice-dedicated-03 serving SolsticeCorp (~12:05 UTC). Error spike ~30% for generation endpoints. Pager triggered P1. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/solstice-dedicated-5xx
oncall-alex: Oncall here, taking it. I'll do quick triage and escalate if needed. Starting checks: recent deploys, node health, autoscaler.
sre-jordan: Jumping on traces/metrics. Early signal: CPU + queue backlog on gpu-node-7; KV-cache miss rate up. Suspect autoscaler/tight batch backlog. Kicking off a scale-up + rolling restart for suspect pods.
oncall-alex: Scaling up pool by +2 nodes now (aws-autoscale group solstice-dedicated-03). ETA ~3m. @cs-rita please prep customer-facing note for SolsticeCorp; include impact, current mitigation, ETA. @acct-hannah get contact list ready.
cs-rita: Drafting now, posting proposed status + customer email below. Will keep it short and explicit.
cs-rita: ```Status page draft:
- Summary: Dedicated capacity for SolsticeCorp observed elevated 5xx errors affecting some generation requests.
- Impact: Partial request failures and increased latency for SolsticeCorp's traffic on solstice-dedicated-03.
- Mitigation: We are scaling the cluster and routing some traffic to fallback capacity; rolling restarts underway.
- ETA: initial mitigation in ~10 minutes; full stabilization under investigation.
- Customer contacts: SolsticeCorp engineering and infra teams notified directly.
We recommend: targeted customer email + status page update.```
acct-hannah: Contact list pulled for SolsticeCorp: primary: eng-lead@solstice.com, ops: infra-ops@solstice.com, security: sec@solstice.com. On-call phones on file (+1-555-01xx masked). Ready to send targeted email once draft approved.
prod-elaine: Suggest adding short workaround instructions for customers: fall back to cached model variant (cached-quantized-v1.2) or smaller batch sizes while we stabilize. Also note we are not seeing data-exfil issues — only availability.
sre-jordan: Scale-up completed, started rolling restarts on 3 pods. Error rate down to ~8% and trending down. Still seeing occasional 5xx spikes for /v1/generate when KV refreshes. Continuing to monitor.
oncall-alex: Good work. I'll post the status page update and send the targeted email to SolsticeCorp contacts. Any objections?
cs-rita: No objections. Send now. I'll follow up with a phone call to confirm receipt and offer support.
oncall-alex: Status page update posted and targeted email sent to primary + ops contacts. Email copy (sent):
"Hello SolsticeCorp team,

We're investigating elevated errors impacting generation requests on your dedicated cluster (solstice-dedicated-03). We have scaled up the pool and are routing traffic to fallback capacity. Initial mitigation completed and error rates are decreasing; we will follow up with a full incident summary and next steps. If you need urgent help, reply to this email or call your account team.

Apologies for the disruption — Alex (Oncall)"
cs-rita: I'll place a quick phone follow-up in 5m. Marking this as ‘Mitigated — monitoring’. Please capture any logs or traces for postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigated by oncall-alex at 1729503600. Postmortem owner assigned: sre-jordan. Severity set P1 -> mitigated. Please file follow-up with timeline and customer impact statement.
prod-elaine: For the postmortem: include routing decision (fallback pool used), autoscaler logs, and the short-term mitigation (cached model suggestion). Also recommend adding an automated fallback rule to avoid manual routing next time.
sre-jordan: Noted — collecting logs/traces now. Will own postmortem draft and include recommended automation.
oncall-alex: Thanks all. Closing the active pager, will reopen if error rate climbs above 15% again.
